conversationalSummary.text: Tomorrow is probably one to skip. Lagide at Evening — 19:00 looks like the least-bad option, but not really something worth chasing. The wind looks like the main issue and could easily make it messy. I'd check Surfline or MEO Beachcam first, but unless it looks surprisingly clean, I'd save the drive.

best.explanation: Lagide looks like a fun-sized window for Fun progression, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 78 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 71/100, and wind is the main risk.  A dependable left-hand reef that turns modest swell into real rides; this is best for clean, playful walls when the bigger beaches are too wild or too small.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is soft and sectiony on the reef shelves.
best.shortExplanation: Lagide is worth a quick check for evening — 19:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide helps a little, but it is not a perfect match.
